builderRule: Last 40 complete calendar years; scan fixed 20-degree boxes south-to-north, west-to-east; first complete monthly record with HR p<0.05 and nonzero Sen sign stable in every annual-boundary window of 15+ years. No tuning.
limitations: Regional box average; not a country outline.
Significance does not identify a cause.
Slope interval does not correct serial dependence.

provenance.citation: GISTEMP Team, 2026: GISS Surface Temperature Analysis (GISTEMP), version 4. NASA GISS. https://data.giss.nasa.gov/gistemp/ (accessed 2026-11-13). Lenssen et al. (2024), doi:10.1029/2023JD040179.

warnings: The Theil–Sen slope interval does not correct for serial dependence; it is distinct from the Hamed–Rao significance test.
High lag-1 serial autocorrelation detected (r1 = 0.88). Autocorrelation can falsely inflate OLS significance; evaluate Hamed-Rao modified Mann-Kendall.
